comparison.objective: Anchor and route a hand line up both flanks of a grass fire; candidate tunes and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-line deployment, anchoring, and terrain routing differ from small rigid-tool engagement, rotary adjustment, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires a road anchor and coverage of both flanks; the record omits routing, containment, tension, and safety thresholds. Candidate requires repeated safe carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Line deployment does not test damper commissioning.
